questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a mapped type?
options: To loop over object properties at runtime.
To map a URL to a server without configuration.
To convert TypeScript to a database schema automatically.
To transform properties by iterating over keys of an existing type.
questions.answer_key: To transform properties by iterating over keys of an existing type.
questions.explanation: Mapped types derive related type shapes and can modify property names or modifiers.

questions.prompt: Which statement is correct about “Mapped Types”?
options: A type assertion automatically validates every value at runtime.
The learner should publish hidden solutions so the exercise can grade itself.
The concept should be demonstrated with mapping over keys and checked against its intended contract.
The safest approach is to skip diagnostics and trust the first output.
questions.answer_key: The concept should be demonstrated with mapping over keys and checked against its intended contract.
questions.explanation: The supplied syllabus explicitly includes “Mapping over keys”; connect it to a concrete example and verify the behavior relevant to this lesson.

questions.prompt: What is a good verification step after practicing “Mapped Types”?

Check transforming property modifiers, include a meaningful failure case where appropriate, and document any runtime or version assumptions.
Assume creating reusable mapped types is unnecessary because the code has type annotations.
Ignore compiler or test failures if the interface looks correct.
questions.answer_key: Check transforming property modifiers, include a meaningful failure case where appropriate, and document any runtime or version assumptions.
